profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Dedicated Software  Engineer committed to maintaining cutting edge technical skills and up-to-date industry knowledge. Bringing  exceptional communication skills and a willingness to learn.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Worked with the customer to architect a Machine Learning Environment that fits their security standards.
•	Authored python code for creating Azure machine learning pipelines. 
•	Lead user interviews for collecting customer pain points in their process and help define requirements and an engagement plan. 
•	Attended customer centric design thinking workshops.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
Member of a CSE Dev Crew
- Performed technical spikes and authored technical design documents
- Acted as the process lead for multiple of the crew’s engagements
- Made over 10 PRs contributions to the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework code repo.
- Made 5 PRs contributions to the Microsoft Open-Source Symphony projects.
- Re-coded an existing C# service for a customer and drastically decreased the processing time of a 1 GB file from over multiple hours to around 50 seconds.
- Created CI/CD pipelines utilizing Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, and GitLab pipelines.
- Created infrastructure deployment scripts using bash, Terraform, and Bicep depending on customer needs.
- Experience deploying resources in a disconnected environment.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Created and groomed user stories
- Helped develop an online retail portal (CarShop.com) for Cox Automotive & Penske.
- Developed the CarShop frontend using React while the backend was developed using Express.
- Also helped architect and configure the cloud resources like AWS Lambda, ElasticSearch, DynamoDB, CodePipeline, CodeBuild, ECR, ECS, and S3 for the CarShop site. 
- Built the CarShop car filtering backend logic for the main search page

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Partnered with Anthem Healthcare to update critical mainframe services into Java
- Created Java Spring boot APIs.

positions.title: Technology Analyst
positions.description:
-  Created multiple ETL(extract, transfer, and load) scheduled jobs in IBM DataStage for transferring
data into a data warehouse.
- Created webpages with graphics and tables for displaying analytics and metrics generated from the
data warehouse. These graphics would be used by upper management to visual metrics on freight
deliveries.

positions.title: Associate Technology Analyst
positions.description:
- Designed, created, and maintained multiple DB2 database tables critical for the Thoroughbred Equipment Asset Management System.
- Optimized DB2 stored procedures.

positions.title: Associate Software Developer
positions.description: Successfully created multiple ASP.NET webpages for a critical application called the Thoroughbred Equipment Asset Management System for railroad systems to be used in regular PC, tablet as well as mobile devices.

certifications.name: Collaborator - Cloud Adoption Framework for Azure
certifications.title: Collaborator - Cloud Adoption Framework for Azure

honors.title: Life Scholarship
honors.issuer: Issued by South Carolina Commission of Higher Education · Jun 2013
